responsibilities.config.py: V2-B lease TTL/concurrency/worktree/runtime-key configuration only; no DB side effects.
responsibilities.principal.py: Load/create stable owner_account_id for the single-owner control plane; read current OAuth AccessToken.client_id only as auth_client_id for session audit. Never use OAuth client_id as account namespace.
responsibilities.tokens.py: Create/load lease-token.key and derive/verify clear lease tokens; never log/persist clear token.
responsibilities.agents.py: Agent/session repository, heartbeat sequence rules and stale/close transitions.
responsibilities.projects.py: Project registration/status and canonical root/project kind metadata.
responsibilities.tasks.py: Task repository/state transitions/checkpoint metadata and project concurrency counting.
responsibilities.leases.py: Task/path lease creation, validation, expiry, takeover and hierarchical conflict checks.
responsibilities.worktrees.py: Deterministic Git worktree/branch provisioning, validation, recovery and cleanup decisions; no DB transaction ownership.
responsibilities.cas.py: CAS intent preparation, filesystem replace, crash reconciliation and result finalization.
responsibilities.guard.py: Legacy write/edit/run_command/direct-job bypass guards based on registered managed-mode state.
responsibilities.jobs.py: Task-scoped wrappers around V2-A DurableService and task/job binding checks.
responsibilities.reconcile.py: Startup/periodic V2-B reconciliation: stale sessions, expired leases, CLAIMED worktree recovery, CAS intents and cleanup_pending.
responsibilities.service.py: Application orchestration only; exact V2-B tool semantics.

forbidden_dependencies: automatic git merge/rebase/reset on user branches
module_layout.server_py_role: Composition root: construct MultiAgentService, pass owner_account_id + current auth_client_id from request context, expose exact tools, and call guard for legacy mutators/direct execution.

migration_002.database_bootstrap_change: Generalize V2-A Database.bootstrap to apply ordered migrations 001 then 002 by exact SHA-256; existing v1 DB upgrades in-place without destructive migration.

principal_and_token.owner_account_id: Stable prefix own_. Create once atomically for the current single-owner control plane; persisted independently from OAuth DCR clients.
principal_and_token.oauth_client_role: mcp.server.auth.middleware.auth_context.get_access_token().client_id is auth_client_id only; missing access token => AUTH_REQUIRED.
principal_and_token.multi_login_device_rule: Different OAuth client IDs from two login machines map to the same owner_account_id and may maintain concurrent ACTIVE sessions. No last-login-wins behavior.
principal_and_token.owner_account_schema: Ensure exactly the current owner_account_id exists in owner_accounts before agent/session mutation.
principal_and_token.key_create: Atomic create-once before MultiAgentService accepts mutations. Existing file must be exactly 32 bytes.
principal_and_token.token_verify: Constant-time compare SHA-256(clear token) with task_leases.lease_token_hash after validating task/session/epoch.
principal_and_token.claim_replay: Re-derive same token from active lease nonce only when task, epoch, agent and session still match; else LEASE_STALE.

agent_register: load stable owner_account_id and derive current auth_client_id before transaction
ensure owner_accounts row exists for owner_account_id
create new ACTIVE session storing current auth_client_id
do not close or stale other ACTIVE sessions of the same owner account
heartbeat: validate agent/session belongs to current owner_account_id; auth_client_id may differ across other concurrent sessions
renew only currently unexpired task/path leases owned by exact session
project_register: canonicalize path under workspace ROOT before transaction
insert unique project or replay exact existing registration
task_create: for GIT resolve base_ref to exact base_commit before DB mutation
insert task CREATED with deterministic branch/worktree metadata
task_claim_phase1: derive principal and validate agent/session ownership
expire stale leases for target project before capacity count
create fresh nonce and derived token hash
set owner agent/session and state CLAIMED
task_claim_external: for GIT provision/recover deterministic task worktree outside SQLite transaction
for NON_GIT validate canonical project root only
no second claimant can win because CLAIMED counts as active and lease row is already committed
task_claim_phase2: revalidate same lease epoch/owner/session and task still CLAIMED
persist operation success WITHOUT clear lease token
derive clear token from current lease and return it only in response
transaction_boundaries.task_claim_failure: If deterministic workspace provisioning is conclusively invalid/conflicting, delete that epoch's task/path leases, clear owner, set RECOVERABLE, preserve external evidence, fail operation final with WORKTREE_* error. Ambiguous external state => keep RECOVERABLE + manual evidence, never delete.
transaction_boundaries.task_block_release: Single DB transaction validates lease, changes RUNNING->BLOCKED, deletes task/path leases, clears owner/session, preserves worktree/jobs, appends event, succeeds operation.
transaction_boundaries.task_release: Single DB transaction validates lease; CLAIMED without provisioned worktree -> READY, otherwise -> RECOVERABLE; delete task/path leases, clear owner/session.
task_complete: preflight outside transaction: validate Git clean branch identity or NON_GIT lease rules, query no non-terminal bound jobs
revalidate current lease and no non-terminal job rows
delete task/path leases, clear owner/session, set finished_at
cleanup is separate best-effort reconciliation and never changes completion verdict
transaction_boundaries.path_lease_acquire: One BEGIN IMMEDIATE validates current task lease and hierarchical conflicts, then inserts path lease with same expiry as task lease.
cas: reserve V2-A operation and validate current task lease/epoch
BEGIN IMMEDIATE: validate required non-Git path lease; compute/store PREPARED cas_mutations intent metadata after a read-only prehash
create unique temp in target directory, fsync, verify temp hash=intended_after_hash
re-read current target hash immediately before replace; mismatch => ABORTED/CAS_MISMATCH, zero replace
BEGIN IMMEDIATE: set cas_mutations REPLACED, verify task lease epoch has not changed; COMMIT
BEGIN IMMEDIATE: set COMMITTED and persist operation result before_hash/after_hash/path/task; append task event; COMMIT

create_or_recover.branch_exists_no_worktree: Verify branch belongs to task namespace. For first provisioning branch must point at base_commit; for takeover/recovery progressed branch is allowed. git worktree add <path> <branch>.
create_or_recover.expected_worktree_exists: Use git worktree list --porcelain; require exact path and exact branch. Never reset.

crash_recovery.CLAIMED_no_worktree: Resume deterministic provision if lease still valid; if lease expired first mark RECOVERABLE and provision only on next claim.
crash_recovery.CLAIMED_worktree_valid: Finalize RUNNING for same lease if claim operation evidence is consistent.
crash_recovery.RUNNING_worktree_missing: RECOVERABLE + WORKTREE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH event; never recreate automatically while jobs may exist.
crash_recovery.terminal_clean_no_jobs: May remove worktree with git worktree remove only after identity revalidation; branch is preserved.

legacy_guard.read_tools: list_dir/read_file/search remain allowed subject to ROOT containment.
legacy_guard.write_file_edit_file: Resolve canonical target. If inside any registered project root OR any recorded task worktree => raise LEASE_REQUIRED_USE_CAS before filesystem mutation. Outside managed areas preserve V2-A behavior.
legacy_guard.run_command: If managed_mode active => raise TASK_CONTEXT_REQUIRED before process spawn.
legacy_guard.direct_job_submit: If managed_mode active => raise TASK_CONTEXT_REQUIRED before V2-A operation reservation.
legacy_guard.direct_job_cancel: If target job joins through operations.task_id to a V2-B task => raise TASK_CONTEXT_REQUIRED.
legacy_guard.guard_failure: Fail closed on DB ambiguity/errors for mutation tools; reads may continue if project registry lookup succeeds or clearly does not cover path.

submit: validate current task lease/epoch and request principal owns supplied agent/session indirectly through lease
resolve task execution root: Git worktree for GIT, project root for NON_GIT
NON_GIT: require current TREE WRITE_EXCLUSIVE path lease on project root '.'
resolve cwd under task execution root
call internal DurableService.job_submit directly with same operation_id and context agent_id/project_id/task_id; server direct-job guard is bypassed only inside this trusted wrapper
operation request hash therefore binds argv/cwd + agent/project/task
task_job_wrappers.list: Join jobs -> operations by operation_id where operations.task_id=<task_id>; no lease required for read, but caller must be authenticated.
cancel: verify target job joins to same task_id
call internal DurableService.job_cancel with same operation_id + current context
stale token never reaches process cancellation
task_job_wrappers.completion_gate: tasks repository checks joined jobs for non-terminal states before task_complete.

cas_recovery.startup_order: After DB migration and lease-key validation, before accepting V2-B mutations.
PREPARED: compute current target hash and temp hash if temp exists
if current==intended_after_hash => set REPLACED then finalize
if current==expected_before_hash and temp hash==intended_after_hash => retry atomic replace once under reconciler ownership, then finalize
otherwise mark operation IN_DOUBT and preserve temp/evidence
cas_recovery.ABORTED: No filesystem action; clean temp only when evidence is unambiguous.
cas_recovery.lease_expiry_during_recovery: Recovery of an already PREPARED same operation may finalize only if replacement had already happened. It must not perform a new replace after task lease epoch is no longer current.

sweep_order: mark sessions STALE by heartbeat age
for each lease in one transaction: delete path leases, delete task lease, RUNNING/CLAIMED->RECOVERABLE, clear owner/session, append LEASE_EXPIRED event
reconcile CLAIMED worktrees only for still-valid leases

failure_injection_matrix: crash after claim phase1 before worktree creation
crash after worktree creation before claim phase2
claim response lost after RUNNING+operation success: same operation re-derives same current token
lease expires before claim external provisioning finishes
late heartbeat after takeover
two claim transactions race at project concurrency boundary
worktree path preexists with wrong identity
worktree branch exists but registered elsewhere
dirty terminal worktree cleanup
CAS crash after PREPARED before temp write
CAS crash after temp write before replace
CAS crash after replace before REPLACED DB state
CAS crash after REPLACED before operation result
CAS lease expires before replace
CAS lease expires after replace but before DB finalize
two CAS writers share same expected hash
legacy write/edit/run_command/direct job_submit bypass attempts
session stale while V2-A durable payload continues
takeover observes same V2-A job
stale claimant cancellation rejected
current claimant cancellation succeeds
server restart with expired leases and running durable jobs
two login devices with different OAuth client IDs concurrently heartbeat without last-login-wins
closing one login-device session leaves the other ACTIVE and its lease valid

qualification_gates.scale: At least 3 agents across at least 2 projects; 2 concurrent tasks in the same Git project use distinct worktrees.
qualification_gates.claim_race: Exactly one winner for same task and no duplicate active lease.
qualification_gates.takeover: Old token rejected after epoch increment; durable job survives and new claimant sees same job.
qualification_gates.cas_race: Two writers from same expected hash => exactly one committed result and one CAS_MISMATCH.
qualification_gates.worktree_recovery: Crash-window fixtures recover deterministically without reset/prune/data loss.
qualification_gates.production: Port 8099/tunnel process identity remains unchanged throughout V2-B implementation qualification.
qualification_gates.multi_login_devices: Same owner account with two distinct auth_client_id sessions concurrently uses V2-B control plane; both remain independently routable by session_id.
qualification_gates.release_sequence: After V2-B formal close, REMOTE_MCP_V2BD_MULTI_DEVICE_ROUTING_PRELOCK is mandatory before release/production switch.

implementation_authorized_after_lock_pas: wire exact V2-B tools in server.py
add periodic V2-B reconciler task without changing V2-A worker semantics
forbidden: change V2-A job state machine or worker protocol
